salidos: salir — gone out, sallied forth (past part. masc. pl. with the auxiliary seer; salidos son 'have gone out'; = salidos)
quarto: Quarto — Cuarte (modern Quart de Poblet), a town a short way west of Valencia; its towers are the gate-towers of the Valencian approach (place name; identification traditional)
guarnizones: guarnizón — armor, equipment, trappings (fem. pl.; = guarniciones, 'fittings, harness'; modern guarnición is mainly 'garrison, trimming')
adobado: adobar — fitted out, equipped, armed (past part. masc.; es adobado 'is fully equipped'; = equipado, arreglado; modern adobar means 'to marinate, tan')
vanlos: ir + los — they go (to) them (van, present 3rd pl., + enclitic los 'them'; vanlos ferir 'they go to strike them'; = los van a herir)
alvaroz: Alvaroz — Álvarez (patronymic, 'son of Álvaro', restored in brackets by the editor; Álvar Álvarez, one of the Cid's captains; = Álvarez)
entráronles: entrar + les — they attacked them (preterite 3rd pl. entraron + enclitic les 'them'; entrar a uno 'to charge, break in on'; = les entraron, 'les atacaron')
arrancarlos: arrancar + los — to rout them (infinitive + enclitic los, 'to drive them off'; = derrotarlos, ahuyentarlos; modern arrancar 'to pull up, start')
enpleó: empleár — he used, put to work (preterite 3rd sg.; enpleó la lança 'he put his lance to use, plied it'; = empleó, 'usó')
atantos: a + tantos — so many (a + tanto, masc. pl.; atantos mata de moros 'so many Moors he kills', the a marking the direct object; = a tantos)
saliósle: salir + se + le — it slipped away from him (preterite 3rd sg. salió + reflexive se + dative le 'from him'; = se le salió, 'se le escapó')
andido: andar — it ran, went (strong preterite 3rd sg., Old Spanish andido/andude type; = anduvo; the horse 'ran' freely, escaping)
metiósle: meter + se + le — he got himself in, took refuge (preterite 3rd sg. metió + reflexive se + dative le; metiósle en Gujera 'he got away into Gujera'; = se le metió, 'se metió')
palaçiano: palaçiano — of a palace, stately, grand (adj. masc.; castiello palaçiano 'a palatial castle'; = palaciego, closest 'señorial, palaciego')
alcanço: alcanço — pursuit, chase (noun; llegar en alcanço 'to come up in pursuit'; = alcance, 'persecución'; the editor's restoration alca[nço])
consiguen: consiguir — they follow, come after (present 3rd pl.; quel consiguen 'who follow him'; = siguen; modern conseguir is 'to obtain, achieve')
desd: desde — from, since (the final -e dropped before a vowel; Desd' allí 'from there'; = desde)
caçado: caçar — hunted down, won, taken (past part.; lo que an caçado 'what they have won'; = cazado, 'ganado'; modern cazar 'to hunt', here figurative, of booty)
rastado: rastar — dragged, drawn along, gathered (past part. after a 'has'; a rastado = ha arrastrado, 'has drawn together/in'; uncertain, the verb rastar is rare and the sense 'gathered (as booty)' is inferred)
fuero: seer/ir — they were (preterite 3rd pl. fueron, with the final -n elided, fuero'; fuero' notados 'were noted'; = fueron)
notados: notar — noted, recorded, counted (past part. masc. pl.; = notados, 'anotados, contados'; modern notar is mainly 'to notice')
desarmado: desarmar — unarmed, with his armor off (past part. as adj.; que era desarmado 'for he was unarmed'; = desarmado; probably 'bareheaded, coif drawn back', uncertain since he still holds the sword)
reçibienlo: reçebir + lo — they received him (imperfect 3rd pl. -ién, 'were receiving', + enclitic lo; = lo recibían; read also as 'they welcome him')
antellas: ante + ellas — before them (fem.) (preposition ante + pronoun ellas, joined; fincó antellas 'he stopped before them'; = ante ellas)
omillo: omillar — I humble myself, bow (present 1st sg. with reflexive me; a vos me omillo 'I bow before you'; = me humillo)
prez: prez — honor, renown, glory (masc./fem. noun, Latin pretium; grant prez 'great honor'; = prez, a literary word; closest honra, fama)
sudiento: sudiento — sweaty, in a lather (adj. masc. sg.; = sudoroso; no exact modern form)
cum: cum — as, like (spelling of como, Latin quomodo; con tal cum esto 'with such as this'; = como)
vençen: vençer — they are defeated (present 3rd pl., passive-reflexive se vençen; = se vencen); also 'they conquer'
viba: bivir — may (he) keep alive, let (him) live (present subjunctive 3rd sg., optative; que vos viba 'may he keep you'; = viva; b/v spellings alternate)
algunt: algún — some, a few (apocopated form before a noun, the -t a graphic variant; algunt año 'some years'; = algún)
entraredes: entrar — you will enter (future 2nd pl.; entraredes en prez 'you will enter into honor'; = entraréis)
besarán: besar — they will kiss (future 3rd pl.; = besarán)
diçiendo: diçir — getting down, dismounting (gerund; diçiendo del cavallo 'dismounting from the horse'; = descendiendo; from Latin descendere, a different verb from dezir 'to say')
descavalgado: descavalgar — dismounted (past part. masc., with era; = descabalgado, desmontado)
buelta: buelta — turn, throng, company (noun; en buelta con él 'in a body with him, together with him'; = vuelta; modern vuelta 'turn, return')
preçiosos: preçioso — precious, costly, fine (adj. masc. pl.; = preciosos)
escaños: escaño — bench, long seat (masc. pl.; = escaños)
nom: non + me — not … me (non with enclitic me, the -e dropped; nom lo aviedes rogado 'had you not asked me for it'; = no me)
aviedes: aver — you had (imperfect 2nd pl., -iedes; aviedes rogado 'you had asked', pluperfect auxiliary; = habíais)
rogado: rogar — asked, begged (past part.; lo aviedes rogado 'you had asked for it'; = rogado)
aduxiestes: aduzir — you brought (strong preterite 2nd pl.; = trajisteis; modern aducir means 'to adduce')
quiérolas: querer + las — I want them (quiero, present 1st sg., + enclitic las; quiérolas casar 'I wish to marry them off'; = las quiero casar)
doles: dar + les — I give them (do, 1st sg. present of dar, + enclitic les 'to them'; = les doy)
quién: quién — whom, who (interrogative/relative; a quién sirvieron tanto 'whom they served so much'; = quién; the accent here is editorial)
espacio: espacio — leisure, time, slowness (noun; por espacio 'at leisure, in good time, later'; = espacio; modern espacio 'space')
levantáronse: levantar + se — they got up (preterite 3rd pl. levantaron + reflexive se; = se levantaron)
acabado: acabar — finished, carried out (past part.; lo han acabado 'they have carried it out'; = acabado)
preçiados: preçiado — valuable, precious (adj. masc. pl.; from preçiar; = preciados)
sobejano: sobejano — superabundant, very great (adj. masc.; from sobejo 'excess'; tanto … que es sobejano 'so much that it is beyond measure'; no modern equivalent, closest sobrado, abundantísimo)
granado: granado — outstanding, notable, remarkable (adj. masc.; lo que es más granado 'what is most remarkable'; = granado, 'notable'; modern granado also 'pomegranate tree')
arriados: arriar — equipped, harnessed, adorned (past part. masc. pl., = arreados; sense uncertain here: either 'fully harnessed' or 'loose, ownerless', said of the horses)
tomallos: tomar + los — to take them (infinitive tomar + enclitic los, rl assimilated to ll; = tomarlos)
otorgados: otorgar — granted, assigned, approved (past part. masc. pl.; de los buenos e otorgados 'of the good and allotted'; = otorgados; sense uncertain, probably 'choice, allotted to him')
cayéronle: caer + le — they fell to him (preterite 3rd pl. cayeron + enclitic le; = le cayeron, 'le tocaron en suerte')
preciada: preçiado — valuable, fine (adj. fem. sg.; = preciada)
tendal: tendal — tent-pole, tent-supports (sg.; see tendales; here tendal obrado 'worked tent-pole'; = poste de la tienda; modern tendal means 'awning')
obrado: obrar — worked, wrought, decorated (past part. masc.; = obrado, labrado)
sufren: sufrir — they bear, support (present 3rd pl.; = sufren; modern sufrir 'to suffer')
labrados: labrar — worked, embroidered (past part. masc. pl.; con oro son labrados 'are worked with gold'; = labrados)
sovisse: seer — it should stay, remain (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., from Latin sedere; que fita sovisse 'that it should stay fixed'; = estuviese)
tolliesse: toller — he should take away, remove (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg.; = quitase; the verb toller no longer exists, closest quitar)
croviesse: creer — he should believe, credit (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg., strong form; = creyese)
farto: farto — sated, weary, having had enough (adj. masc.; farto de lidiar 'weary of fighting'; = harto)
matados: matar — killed (past part. masc. pl.; los moros que ha matados 'the Moors he has killed'; = matados)
cadié: caer — it fell, came (imperfect 3rd sg. -ié; ca[d]ié a él 'fell to his share'; = caía, 'le tocaba')
diezmo: diezmo — tenth, tithe (masc. noun; = diezmo; here the tenth part of the Cid's fifth)

__broaden__.sol: sol — sun · also 'even, so much as' (sol non 'not even'; sol non será penssado 'it will not even be thought of') · also sol — in saliósle del sol espada the sense is uncertain; perhaps 'from under (his) sword' (sol = Latin solum 'ground, underside'), or an error for so 'his'
__broaden__.cabo: cabo — beside, next to (preposition; cf. modern cabe) · also cabo — end (noun; fasta cabo del año, 'until the end of the year') · also de cabo — 'again, anew' (que los cometamos de cabo 'that we attack them again'; = de nuevo) · also a cabo de — at the end of, after (a cabo de tres sedmanas 'after three weeks') · also cabo — side, flank (del otro cabo 'from the other side'); a cabo 'to the end' (de la cabeça fasta a cabo 'from head to tail'); cabo — chief, outermost (de las otras es cabo 'it is the chief of the others', sense uncertain)
__broaden__.preçió: preçiar — he was esteemed (preterite 3rd sg., with se 'became prized, famous'; se preçió Bavieca 'Bavieca became famous'; = fue apreciado; modern se preció would mean 'prided himself') · also preçiar — he valued, praised (active, with personal a; allí preçió a Bavieca 'there he prized Bavieca'; = apreció, valoró)
__broaden__.venida: venir — come, arrived (past part. fem. sg. with ser; venida es la mañana 'morning has come'; = venida) · also venida — arrival, coming (noun; en vuestra venida 'at your arrival'; = venida)
__broaden__.venir: venir — to come (infinitive; = venir) · also venir se a — 'will come about' (split future, venir + se + a = ha; venir se a más por espacio 'will come about later at leisure'; = se vendrá)
__broaden__.más: más — more; e más 'and moreover' · non más 'no more, nothing more'; por que más valdrá 'whereby he will be worth more' · also más por espacio — 'later, at more leisure' (más 'further'; por espacio 'in good time')
__broaden__.ha: aver — he has (3rd sg. present; = ha) · ha — to (a with h-, aver a + inf. 'will, must': lo an todos ha far 'all are to do it'); aver — has, possesses (las fijas que ha 'the daughters she has') · also ha — future ending after infinitive + clitics, the split future (tornar nos la ha 'he will give it back to us'; = nos la tornará) · also ha — there is, there are (impersonal; dos señas ha cabdales 'there are two chief banners'; = hay) · also ha — perfect auxiliary 'has' before the participle (ha vendido 'has sold'; fechos los ha ricos 'has made them rich') · also 'has, gets' (de señor non ha graçia 'he has no favor from a lord') · also ha de + inf. 'is to' (que los ha de aguardar 'who is to attend them'; aver de + infinitive, = ha de) · also non ha qui + inf. — 'there is no one to' (impersonal ha 'there is'; non ha qui tomallos 'there is no one to take them'; = no hay quien)
__broaden__.qui: qui — he who, whoever (old relative pronoun, Latin qui; = quien) · also qui — who? (interrogative; ¿qui los podrié contar? 'who could count them?'; = quién) · also qui after a negative — 'anyone who, one to' (non ha qui tomallos 'there is nobody to take them'; = quien)
__broaden__.tiene: tener — he has (present 3rd sg.) · also tener en cuenta — 'he takes account of, counts' (non tiene en cuenta 'he does not keep count'; = tiene en cuenta)
__broaden__.mata: mata — thicket, scrub; here in the place name Mata de Taranz, which Pidal identifies with today's campo Taranz, a stony plain over the head of the valley of Arbujuelo, between the provinces of Soria and Guadalajara (noun; = mata) · also matar — he kills (present 3rd sg.; atantos mata de moros 'he kills so many Moors'; = mata, unrelated to the noun mata)
